paragraphs.text: translated by
1. I CALL the Gods of lofty glory for our weal, the makers of the light, well-skilled in sacrifice;
paragraphs.original: देवान्हुवे बृहच्छ्रवसः स्वस्तये ज्योतिष्कृतो अध्वरस्य प्रचेतसः ।
paragraphs.translit: devānhuve bṛhacchravasaḥ svastaye jyotiṣkṛto adhvarasya pracetasaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Those who have waxen mightily, Masters of all wealth, Immortal, strengthening Law, the Gods whom Indra leads.
paragraphs.original: ये वावृधुः प्रतरं विश्ववेदस इन्द्रज्येष्ठासो अमृता ऋतावृधः
paragraphs.translit: ye vāvṛdhuḥ prataraṃ viśvavedasa indrajyeṣṭhāso amṛtā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. For the strong band of Maruts will we frame a hymn: the chiefs shall bring forth sacrifice for Indra's troop,
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रप्रसूता वरुणप्रशिष्टा ये सूर्यस्य ज्योतिषो भागमानशुः ।
paragraphs.translit: indraprasūtā varuṇapraśiṣṭā ye sūryasya jyotiṣo bhāgamānaśuḥ |

paragraphs.text: Who, sent by Indra and advised by Varuna, have gotten for themselves a share of Surya's light
paragraphs.original: मरुद्गणे वृजने मन्म धीमहि माघोने यज्ञं जनयन्त सूरयः
paragraphs.translit: marudgaṇe vṛjane manma dhīmahi māghone yajñaṃ janayanta sūrayaḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. May Indra with the Vasus keep our dwelling safe, and Aditi with Adityas lend us sure defence.
paragraphs.original: इन्द्रो वसुभिः परि पातु नो गयमादित्यैर्नो अदितिः शर्म यच्छतु ।
paragraphs.translit: indro vasubhiḥ pari pātu no gayamādityairno aditiḥ śarma yacchatu |

paragraphs.text: May the God Rudra with the Rudras favour us, and Tvastar with the Dames further us to success.
paragraphs.original: रुद्रो रुद्रेभिर्देवो मृळयाति नस्त्वष्टा नो ग्नाभिः सुविताय जिन्वतु
paragraphs.translit: rudro rudrebhirdevo mṛḷayāti nastvaṣṭā no gnābhiḥ suvitāya jinvatu

paragraphs.text: 4. Aditi, Heaven and Earth, the great eternal Law, Indra, Visnu, the Maruts, and the lofty Sky.
paragraphs.original: अदितिर्द्यावापृथिवी ऋतं महदिन्द्राविष्णू मरुतः स्वर्बृहत् ।
paragraphs.translit: aditirdyāvāpṛthivī ṛtaṃ mahadindrāviṣṇū marutaḥ svarbṛhat |

paragraphs.text: We call upon Adityas, on the Gods, for help, on Vasus, Rudras, Savitar of wondrous deeds.
paragraphs.original: देवाँ आदित्याँ अवसे हवामहे वसून्रुद्रान्सवितारं सुदंससम्
paragraphs.translit: devām̐ ādityām̐ avase havāmahe vasūnrudrānsavitāraṃ sudaṃsasam

paragraphs.text: 5. With Holy Thoughts Sarasvan, firm-lawed Varuna, great Vayu, Pusan, Visnu, and the Asvins Twain,
paragraphs.original: सरस्वान्धीभिर्वरुणो धृतव्रतः पूषा विष्णुर्महिमा वायुरश्विना ।
paragraphs.translit: sarasvāndhībhirvaruṇo dhṛtavrataḥ pūṣā viṣṇurmahimā vāyuraśvinā |

paragraphs.text: Lords of all wealth, Immortal, furtherers of prayer, grant us a triply-guarding refuge from distress.
paragraphs.original: ब्रह्मकृतो अमृता विश्ववेदसः शर्म नो यंसन्त्रिवरूथमंहसः
paragraphs.translit: brahmakṛto amṛtā viśvavedasaḥ śarma no yaṃsantrivarūthamaṃhasaḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. Strong be the sacrifice, strong be the Holy Ones, strong the preparers of oblation, strong the Gods.
paragraphs.original: वृषा यज्ञो वृषणः सन्तु यज्ञिया वृषणो देवा वृषणो हविष्कृतः ।
paragraphs.translit: vṛṣā yajño vṛṣaṇaḥ santu yajñiyā vṛṣaṇo devā vṛṣaṇo haviṣkṛtaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Mighty be Heaven and Earth, true to eternal Law, strong be Parjanya, strong be they who laud the Strong.
paragraphs.original: वृषणा द्यावापृथिवी ऋतावरी वृषा पर्जन्यो वृषणो वृषस्तुभः
paragraphs.translit: vṛṣaṇā dyāvāpṛthivī ṛtāvarī vṛṣā parjanyo vṛṣaṇo vṛṣastubhaḥ

paragraphs.text: 7. To win us strength I glorify the Mighty Twain, Agni and Soma, Mighty Ones whom many laud.
paragraphs.original: अग्नीषोमा वृषणा वाजसातये पुरुप्रशस्ता वृषणा उप ब्रुवे ।
paragraphs.translit: agnīṣomā vṛṣaṇā vājasātaye purupraśastā vṛṣaṇā upa bruve |

paragraphs.text: May these vouchsafe us shelter with a triple guard, these whom the strong have served in worship of the Gods.
paragraphs.original: यावीजिरे वृषणो देवयज्यया ता नः शर्म त्रिवरूथं वि यंसतः
paragraphs.translit: yāvījire vṛṣaṇo devayajyayā tā naḥ śarma trivarūthaṃ vi yaṃsataḥ

paragraphs.text: 8. Potent, with firm-fixt laws, arranging sacrifice, visiting solemn rites in splendour of the day,
paragraphs.original: धृतव्रताः क्षत्रिया यज्ञनिष्कृतो बृहद्दिवा अध्वराणामभिश्रियः ।
paragraphs.translit: dhṛtavratāḥ kṣatriyā yajñaniṣkṛto bṛhaddivā adhvarāṇāmabhiśriyaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Obeying Order, these whose priest is Agni, free from falsehood, poured the waters out when Vrtra died.
paragraphs.original: अग्निहोतार ऋतसापो अद्रुहोऽपो असृजन्ननु वृत्रतूर्ये
paragraphs.translit: agnihotāra ṛtasāpo adruho'po asṛjannanu vṛtratūrye

paragraphs.text: 9. The Holy Ones engendered, for their several laws, the heavens and earth, the waters, and the plants and trees.
paragraphs.original: द्यावापृथिवी जनयन्नभि व्रताप ओषधीर्वनिनानि यज्ञिया ।
paragraphs.translit: dyāvāpṛthivī janayannabhi vratāpa oṣadhīrvanināni yajñiyā |

paragraphs.text: They filled the firmament with heavenly light for help: the Gods embodied Wish and made it beautiful.
paragraphs.original: अन्तरिक्षं स्वरा पप्रुरूतये वशं देवासस्तन्वी नि मामृजुः
paragraphs.translit: antarikṣaṃ svarā paprurūtaye vaśaṃ devāsastanvī ni māmṛjuḥ

paragraphs.text: 10. May they who bear up heaven, the Rbhus deft of hand, and Vata and Parjanya of the thundering Bull,
paragraphs.original: धर्तारो दिव ऋभवः सुहस्ता वातापर्जन्या महिषस्य तन्यतोः ।
paragraphs.translit: dhartāro diva ṛbhavaḥ suhastā vātāparjanyā mahiṣasya tanyatoḥ |

paragraphs.text: The waters and the plants, promote the songs we sing: come Bhaga, Rati, and the Vaijns to my call.
paragraphs.original: आप ओषधीः प्र तिरन्तु नो गिरो भगो रातिर्वाजिनो यन्तु मे हवम्
paragraphs.translit: āpa oṣadhīḥ pra tirantu no giro bhago rātirvājino yantu me havam

paragraphs.text: 11. Sindhu, the sea, the region, and the firmament, the thunder, and the ocean, Aja-Ekapad,
paragraphs.original: समुद्रः सिन्धू रजो अन्तरिक्षमज एकपात्तनयित्नुरर्णवः ।
paragraphs.translit: samudraḥ sindhū rajo antarikṣamaja ekapāttanayitnurarṇavaḥ |

paragraphs.text: The Dragon of the Deep, shall listen to my words, and all the Deities and Princes shall give ear.
paragraphs.original: अहिर्बुध्न्यः शृणवद्वचांसि मे विश्वे देवास उत सूरयो मम
paragraphs.translit: ahirbudhnyaḥ śṛṇavadvacāṃsi me viśve devāsa uta sūrayo mama

paragraphs.text: 12. May we, be yours, we men, to entertain the Gods: further our sacrifice and give it full success.
paragraphs.original: स्याम वो मनवो देववीतये प्राञ्चं नो यज्ञं प्र णयत साधुया ।
paragraphs.translit: syāma vo manavo devavītaye prāñcaṃ no yajñaṃ pra ṇayata sādhuyā |

paragraphs.text: Adityas, Rudras, Vasus, givers of good gifts, quicken the holy hymns which we are singing now
paragraphs.original: आदित्या रुद्रा वसवः सुदानव इमा ब्रह्म शस्यमानानि जिन्वत
paragraphs.translit: ādityā rudrā vasavaḥ sudānava imā brahma śasyamānāni jinvata

paragraphs.text: 13. I follow with success upon the path of Law the two celestial Hotars, Priests of oldest time.
paragraphs.original: दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा पुरोहित ऋतस्य पन्थामन्वेमि साधुया ।
paragraphs.translit: daivyā hotārā prathamā purohita ṛtasya panthāmanvemi sādhuyā |

paragraphs.text: We pray to him who dwelleth near, Guard of the Field, to all Immortal Gods who never are remiss.
paragraphs.original: क्षेत्रस्य पतिं प्रतिवेशमीमहे विश्वान्देवाँ अमृताँ अप्रयुच्छतः
paragraphs.translit: kṣetrasya patiṃ prativeśamīmahe viśvāndevām̐ amṛtām̐ aprayucchataḥ

paragraphs.text: 14. Vasistha's sons have raised their voices, like their sire. Rsi-like praying to the Gods for happiness.
paragraphs.original: वसिष्ठासः पितृवद्वाचमक्रत देवाँ ईळाना ऋषिवत्स्वस्तये ।
paragraphs.translit: vasiṣṭhāsaḥ pitṛvadvācamakrata devām̐ īḷānā ṛṣivatsvastaye |

paragraphs.text: Like friendly-minded kinsmen, come at our desire, O Gods, and shake down treasures on us from above.
paragraphs.original: प्रीता इव ज्ञातयः काममेत्यास्मे देवासोऽव धूनुता वसु
paragraphs.translit: prītā iva jñātayaḥ kāmametyāsme devāso'va dhūnutā vasu

paragraphs.text: 15. Immortal Gods have I, Vasistha, lauded, Gods set on high above all other beings.
paragraphs.original: देवान्वसिष्ठो अमृतान्ववन्दे ये विश्वा भुवनाभि प्रतस्थुः ।
paragraphs.translit: devānvasiṣṭho amṛtānvavande ye viśvā bhuvanābhi pratasthuḥ |

paragraphs.text: May they this day grant us wide space and freedom: ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.
paragraphs.original: ते नो रासन्तामुरुगायमद्य यूयं पात स्वस्तिभिः सदा नः
paragraphs.translit: te no rāsantāmurugāyamadya yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
